title.narrative: Suqia Al-Khair: Drilling 290 wells in Niger

description.narrative: - Providing the source of life, which is also considered one of the most important sources of development: water. - Helping to alleviate the suffering of families as a result of bringing water from distant places. - Contributing to establishing stability and social security by providing water to all
Providing potable water as an ongoing charity for the Nigerian people, the project consists of drilling three types of wells

Supporting rural development and environmental health by encouraging agriculture with wells - Approximately 393,390 people have benefited from potable water for years - The number of wells that will be delivered is 290 (medium artesian, deep with solar-powered pumps, and shallow with a hand pump) - Resisting the water crisis and pollution diseases from During the project - training at least 740 people to maintain and monitor wells, two people for each well.
